data.gender_notes: Nujaimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Najm' which means 'star'. Nujaimah is a name for a victorious one, a star that shines brightly. In Islamic tradition, stars are believed to be angels who carry God's commandments to the Earth. The name Nujaimah carries the meaning “Victorious one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nujaimah usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nujaimah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
